notes.title: SuperEpic new Map Update!
notes.content:
[h3]A new SuperEpic update is out now![/h3]

After a month of its original release and with all the great user feedback received, we're happy to announce that [b]SuperEpic's first update[/b] is now available on Steam and it's coming soon to other platforms!

This update's main focus was to[b] improve the in-game map's usability[/b] and include the much requested "reminder" option. With this feature players can add or remove a marker in the current room they're visiting, so they will remember there's something special to come back for later.

Here's an example of how this works:

[previewyoutube=nA8X0siAsAw;full][/previewyoutube]

This feature will work [b]both on Story and Roguelite mode[/b]!

But that's not the only map-related improvement. We've also added new elevator icons, which now show the associated floor number, and a few other important markers, such as the HR lady!

A few other minor issues were fixed for a better overall experience. Thanks to all the reviewers and players for their valuable feedback! We hope you enjoy the new SuperEpic features!

Best wishes, 
The Undercoders and Numskull Games team
